args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs. Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, for the record:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. It is the Mid-Atlantic home goods account.
- "PHL" is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so the shorthand returns both accounts in search and in the morning report.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living.

Could you point me at whoever owns the saved report so the label gets corrected?

Thanks,
Sofia
